195:35.en: 「$$ノノ$$ is a member of $$フラタニティ$$ too!」

195:74.en: 「I'll do it! I'll prove I can!」

195:113.en: 「Just because I'm the sweets type,\nmy attacks aren't sweet!」

195:281.en: 「Only hard work makes me $$ノノリリ$$!」

195:324.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will fight like $$ノノリリ$$!」

195:361.en: 「I'll show you how serious $$ノノ$$ is!」

195:433.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will fight for peace too!」

195:466.en: 「To become $$トップレス$$, I train daily!」

195:507.en: 「You can't fight half-heartedly\nif you want to become $$トップレス$$!」

195:562.en: 「I'm still an apprentice, but I'll\ndo my best with hard work and guts!」

195:617.en: 「$$フラタニティ$$'s great hope!\nHere comes $$ノノ$$!」

195:670.en: 「The unit doesn't matter,\nwhat I need is heart!」

195:719.en: 「$$ノノ$$ has a Buster Machine\nin her heart!」

195:768.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will guard Big Sis's homeland!」

195:846.en: 「As the junior Buster Machine,\nI'll protect my senior!」

195:901.en: 「Buster Machine No. 3!\nLeave the defense to $$ノノ$$!」

195:1050.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will face the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

195:1085.en: 「Even without a Buster Machine,\nI'll defeat the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

195:1142.en: 「A justice unit vs. space monsters!\nThat's $$フラタニティ$$!」

195:1203.en: 「In the name of $$フラタニティ$$,\nI can't afford to lose!」

195:1313.en: 「Hmm?\nI feel a really hot gaze on me...!」

195:1405.en: 「Whoa!\nThis speed is making my head spin!」

195:1460.en: 「Why do you hold malice\nand deny humanity!」

195:1509.en: 「A real space monster!\nThe true enemy we'll defeat!」

195:1560.en: 「Smashing is what I'm best at!\nSo even barriers are no problem!」

195:1654.en: 「I'll go easy on you, so\nplease bear with it a little!」

195:1740.en: 「You obey even a wrong order...!\nIs that really okay!」

195:1838.en: 「Machines and humans can be friends!\nDon't you understand!」

195:1936.en: 「I don't mean to hurt you!\nPlease get out of your unit!」

195:2036.en: 「$$ノノ$$ will punish the bad guys!」

195:2194.en: 「To think creatures like this exist,\nspace is vast!」

195:2245.en: 「Someday I'll be $$フラタニティ$$'s ace...!\nI can't lose!」

195:2304.en: 「Even a $$ガンダム$$ doesn't scare me!」

195:2347.en: 「The bigger the opponent,\nthe more $$ノノ$$'s heart burns!」

195:2400.en: 「Fast opponents, I see\nwith $$ノノ$$'s mind's eye!」

195:2449.en: 「Ideals must not be forced on others!」

195:2492.en: 「Floor stains or villains,\nleave the cleaning to me!」

195:2545.en: 「The final battle!\nNot retreating is a maiden's pride!」

195:2596.en: 「Evil organizations get smashed!\nIf $$ノノ$$ doesn't do it, who will!」

195:2653.en: 「$$ノノ$$ won't forgive the $$サイデリアル$$\nfor ruling over people!」

195:2708.en: 「With hard work and guts,\nI'm not afraid of Spheres either!」

195:2767.en: 「Inside $$ノノ$$ is a Sphere\nof hard work and guts!」

195:2820.en: 「There you are!\nEvil Emperor $$アウストラリス$$!」

195:2869.en: 「I have hard work and guts, you have\na $$次元将$$ and Spheres! Even match!」

195:2944.en: 「Having a reason doesn't mean\nyou can do evil!」

195:3001.en: 「Wearing black like that is why\nyou feel down! Let's wear pink.」

195:3074.en: 「$$ノノ$$ firmly opposes\nthe way you think!」

195:3127.en: 「If you say you're emissaries of God,\ndo better things!」

195:3190.en: 「$$ノノ$$ won't be fooled by that smile!」

195:3229.en: 「You tricked $$ノノ$$'s friends,\nso I won't forgive you!」

195:3278.en: 「Treating people as less than human!\n$$ノノ$$ will never forgive that!」

195:3339.en: 「Don't you understand!\nThe universe won't accept you!」

195:3400.en: 「You haven't studied enough!\nNever make one person above another!」

195:3463.en: 「Keep doing that and\nthe real God will abandon you!」

195:3543.en: 「Leave the shooting match to me too!」

195:3686.en: 「It's all crackle and zap, you know!」

195:3721.en: 「From this position, this is the one!」

195:4112.en: 「Here it comes! It's here!\nIt's $$ノノ$$'s turn!」

195:4241.en: 「Rest assured!\nI've had my team training properly~!」

195:4302.en: 「Your junior $$ノノ$$ is a capable girl!\nSupport is my specialty!」

195:4361.en: 「I'll back up the $$バスターマシン$$!」

195:4437.en: 「Every time I see you fight, Big Sis,\nit gets me fired up!」

195:4490.en: 「As expected of $$チコ$$!\n$$ノノ$$ can't afford to lose either!」

195:4547.en: 「Catch up to $$ニコラ$$, then pass him!」

195:4588.en: 「$$ノリコ$$!\nHard work, guts, plus my friendship!」

195:4645.en: 「Fighting alongside $$ノノリリ$$...\n$$ノノ$$ is overjoyed!」

195:4702.en: 「$$シモン$$!\nNo, let me call you Great Bro!」

195:4796.en: 「Leave the rest to Big Sis $$ノノ$$!」

195:4837.en: 「Fellow machines, let's\nbeat evil with fiery friendship!」

195:4960.en: 「We help each other when in need...!\nThose are Big Sis's words!」

195:5054.en: 「$$ノノ$$ is a member of $$フラタニティ$$ too!」

195:5089.en: 「Ain't in my nature to overlook\na comrade in danger, if ya please!」

195:5142.en: 「Not the $$バスターマシン$$, you don't!」

195:5179.en: 「When Big Sis is in a pinch,\n$$ノノ$$ will come to the rescue!」

195:5228.en: 「For Big Sis, I'll be a shield\nfrom the front or side, anything!」

195:5285.en: 「I won't let anyone take down $$チコ$$!」

195:5416.en: 「Protecting young boys and girls\nis natural for a hero of justice!」

195:5557.en: 「Machine to machine,\nwe help each other in a pinch!」

195:5808.en: 「If $$ノノ$$ hits, the rest gets easier!」

195:5890.en: 「Like this,\nI'm stuck and can't get anywhere!」

195:5939.en: 「I'll get out of this adversity\nwith hard work and guts!」

195:5992.en: 「If it comes to this, I must\nuse $$ノノ$$'s direct Inazuma Kick...!」

195:6053.en: 「From now on, I intend to live\nby the motto of thrift and saving!」

195:6163.en: 「What?!\nI was attacked from out of nowhere!」

195:6278.en: 「See? I do deliver when it counts!」

195:6373.en: 「Piloting skills Big Sis praised too!\nAhem! Brag, brag~!」

195:6438.en: 「Heh heh heh...!\nYou can't beat $$ノノ$$ like that!」

195:6493.en: 「Machine Weapons are\n$$ノノ$$'s hands and feet!」

195:6550.en: 「What is this...\nIt's like scouting, not fighting...?」

195:6650.en: 「$$宇宙怪獣$$ are nothing to fear!」

195:6906.en: 「Eek, I was a little startled...!\nJust a little!」

195:7000.en: 「Aah! The corner of my unit\nis all dented!」

195:7098.en: 「I'm not clumsy!\nI just made a mistake!」

195:7151.en: 「$$ノノ$$ and Machine Weapons are tough!」

195:7262.en: 「Guuh!\nThe big head is wobbling like crazy!」

195:7424.en: 「I can't make Big Sis\nworry any more than this...!」

195:7475.en: 「Not yet!\nGive up, and the game is over!」

195:7530.en: 「If only $$ノノ$$ had a $$バスターマシン$$~!」

195:7606.en: 「Oh...?\nAre you maybe holding back on me...?」

195:7655.en: 「Can't underestimate them,\n$$宇宙怪獣$$ are formidable foes!」

195:7706.en: 「$$フラタニティ$$ can't lose\nto $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

195:7759.en: 「I never give up, whatever the pinch!\nThat's a maiden's policy!」

195:7849.en: 「I won't whine in front of Big Sis!」

195:7886.en: 「Stop it, please!\nI'll get yelled at if I break it~!」

195:7998.en: 「$$ノノ$$ believes in herself...!\nAnd she'll get up again and again!」

195:8063.en: 「Somehow pulling through this\nis a maiden's sheer guts!」

195:8112.en: 「$$ノノ$$ won't give up! Because!\n$$ノノリリ$$ never gives up!」

195:8183.en: 「$$ノノリリ$$ would surely\nturn this around from here!」

195:8238.en: 「Eep!\nT-This is when I need to stay calm!」

195:8293.en: 「Only by coming back alive\nis one a true space pilot!」

195:8381.en: 「I'm terribly sorry!\nThis is the blunder of $$ノノ$$'s life!」

195:8461.en: 「Even $$ノノ$$ could...\nif only I had a $$バスターマシン$$...!」

195:8512.en: 「Guh! As a $$バスターマシン$$,\nI couldn't fulfill my mission...!」

195:8571.en: 「Becaaause $$ノノ$$ wants to be $$ノノリリ$$!」

195:8793.en: 「Big Sis, something feels off about the $$Ｄトレーダー$$. $$Ｚクリスタル$$...? Is this a new command?」

195:8882.en: 「Oh my! Then with the power of $$Ｚクリスタル$$, can $$ノノ$$ gain sexy, wild, lolita and tsundere attribute effects too...」

195:8985.en: 「A beautiful pink-haired girl descends on Mars, looking like an angel or a swan...! Who could she really be...!」

195:9137.en: 「T-$$チコ$$?! What's the big idea?! Stealing even the best part of the preview~!」

195:9220.en: 「Big Sis, Big Sis! It's break time~! Let's enjoy our break with hard work and guts!」

195:9311.en: 「No way~! Take those two away and nothing's left~!」

195:9378.en: 「Shock! Stars fell from $$ノノ$$'s eyes! In that case, Player, please level $$ノノ$$ up so she can learn Spirit Commands besides hard work and guts ASAP!」

195:9535.en: 「I got shot down again.... Subtract the repair cost from the money earned on this stage, and, um, the balance is a mere 1,500 yen...」

195:9650.en: 「That's how it is, everyone! Please come back soon!」

195:9764.en: 「Well then, everyone! Let's do our best again with hard work and guts!」

195:9872.en: 「No good? I thought it was a nice duo name, like $$ノノリリ$$...」

195:9939.en: 「And if we both get even more pumped, we become the Nori-Nori Nononoriko, and if that goes out to a field, it becomes the Field Nori-Nori Nononoriko...」

195:10064.en: 「Oh no! $$ノリコ$$'s morale is dropping! She needs to rest a bit!」

195:10143.en: 「Well then, everyone! Take care of Nononono... um... Nononoriko again!」

195:10220.en: 「$$ノリコ$$ lent it to me! I've got $$ディスヌフ$$ too, no problem! $$ノリコ$$! Can Big Sis play with us too?」

195:10339.en: 「Right! Well then! Player! Thank you for your hard work!」

195:10437.en: 「If even God had a wish, I wonder what God would pray to...」

195:10506.en: 「People fight to make their wishes come true..... But a wall always stands in the way...」

195:10585.en: 「But people fight.... Believing in the future full of light beyond...」

195:10642.en: 「Next time, 'SRW Z3: Tengoku-hen'. 'Twelve Thousand Years of Miracles'...」

195:10717.en: 「See, Big Sis! If $$ノノ$$ puts her mind to it, she can do mellow just fine too!」

195:10796.en: 「$$地球帝国宇宙軍$$ Solar System Direct Defense Unit, Sixth-Generation Interstellar Decisive Weapon, $$バスターマシン７号$$!」
